# Contour — Installation Plan

## Overview

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Project | [Contour](https://github.com/projectcontour/contour) |
| Version | **v1.33.4** (official rendered manifests) |
| Namespace | `projectcontour` (official default) |
| Install method | Official rendered manifests (`examples/render/contour.yaml`) |
| Cluster | `kind-otel-eval-contour` |

> **Note:** The Bitnami Helm chart (`bitnami/contour` v21.1.4, app version 1.32.1) was attempted first but the Bitnami images (`bitnami/contour:1.32.1-debian-12-r0`, `bitnami/envoy:1.34.5-debian-12-r0`) are no longer available on Docker Hub. Bitnami moved all images to their own registry. Fell back to the official Contour manifests which use `ghcr.io/projectcontour/contour:v1.33.4` and `docker.io/envoyproxy/envoy:distroless-v1.35.10`.

---

## 1. Installation Method

```bash
# Pre-pull images and load into kind cluster
docker pull ghcr.io/projectcontour/contour:v1.33.4
docker pull docker.io/envoyproxy/envoy:distroless-v1.35.10
kind load docker-image ghcr.io/projectcontour/contour:v1.33.4 --name otel-eval-contour
kind load docker-image docker.io/envoyproxy/envoy:distroless-v1.35.10 --name otel-eval-contour

# Install Contour via official manifests
kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/projectcontour/contour/v1.33.4/examples/render/contour.yaml

# Wait for rollout
kubectl rollout status deployment/contour -n projectcontour --timeout=120s
kubectl rollout status daemonset/envoy -n projectcontour --timeout=120s
```

**What is installed:**
- Namespace: `projectcontour`
- CRDs: `HTTPProxy`, `TLSCertificateDelegation`, `ExtensionService`, `ContourConfiguration`, `ContourDeployment`
- Contour control plane: `Deployment/contour` (2 replicas)
- Envoy data plane: `DaemonSet/envoy`
- Services: `contour` (ClusterIP, xDS port 8001), `envoy` (LoadBalancer, ports 80/443)

---

## 2. Telemetry Configuration

### 2a. Prometheus Metrics — Expose Metrics Ports

The official manifests do not expose the metrics ports via Kubernetes Services. Create dedicated services:

```yaml
# contour-metrics service (Contour control plane, port 8000)
# envoy-metrics service (Envoy data plane, port 8002)
```

Applied: `.otel-eval/contour/contour/routing/metrics-services.yaml`

**Important:** Envoy's metrics endpoint is at `/stats/prometheus`, NOT `/metrics`. The Prometheus receiver's `metrics_path` must be set explicitly.

### 2b. Distributed Traces — OTLP via ExtensionService

Contour routes Envoy's OTel trace export through its `ExtensionService` CRD.

**Constraint:** `ExtensionService` only supports services in the **same namespace** and does NOT support `ExternalName` services. Since the OTel Collector is in the `opentelemetry` namespace, a bridge is needed:

```yaml
# 1. ClusterIP Service in projectcontour namespace pointing to collector ClusterIP
# 2. Manual Endpoints object pointing to collector's ClusterIP (10.96.225.200:4317)
# 3. ExtensionService referencing that ClusterIP service
```

Applied: `.otel-eval/contour/contour/routing/tracing-extensionservice.yaml`

Then patch the Contour ConfigMap to enable tracing:

```yaml
tracing:
  extensionService: projectcontour/otel-collector
  serviceName: contour
  overallSampling: 100
  includePodDetail: true
```

Applied: `.otel-eval/contour/contour/routing/contour-configmap-tracing.yaml`

**Restart required:** Both the Contour deployment AND the Envoy DaemonSet must be restarted after the ConfigMap change.

---

## 3. Collector Changes

Updated `.otel-eval/contour/collector/values.yaml` to add a Prometheus receiver with scrape configs:

```yaml
receivers:
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
        - job_name: contour-control-plane
          scrape_interval: 15s
          static_configs:
            - targets:
                - contour-metrics.projectcontour.svc.cluster.local:8000
        - job_name: envoy-data-plane
          scrape_interval: 15s
          metrics_path: /stats/prometheus    # IMPORTANT: not /metrics
          static_configs:
            - targets:
                - envoy-metrics.projectcontour.svc.cluster.local:8002
```

Added `prometheus` to the metrics pipeline receivers list. Applied via:

```bash
helm upgrade otel-collector open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector \
    --namespace opentelemetry \
    -f .otel-eval/contour/collector/values.yaml \
    --wait
```

---

## 4. Routing / Ingress Setup

Created an `HTTPProxy` resource to route traffic to the test backend:

```yaml
apiVersion: projectcontour.io/v1
kind: HTTPProxy
metadata:
  name: otel-eval-backend
  namespace: demo
spec:
  virtualhost:
    fqdn: otel-eval-backend.local
  routes:
    - conditions:
        - prefix: /
      services:
        - name: otel-eval-backend
          port: 3000
```

Applied: `.otel-eval/contour/contour/routing/httpproxy.yaml`

Traffic is sent via `kubectl port-forward` to the Envoy service with the `Host: otel-eval-backend.local` header.

---

## 5. Traffic Generation

```bash
# Port-forward to Envoy
kubectl port-forward -n projectcontour svc/envoy 8888:80 &

# Without trace context (Envoy starts new traces)
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
    curl -s -H "Host: otel-eval-backend.local" http://localhost:8888/ > /dev/null
done

# With W3C traceparent (Envoy propagates context)
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
    curl -s \
        -H "Host: otel-eval-backend.local" \
        -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" \
        http://localhost:8888/ > /dev/null
done
```

## 6. Telemetry Status (Actual Results)

| Signal | Status | Method | Notes |
|--------|--------|--------|-------|
| Traces | **Flowing** | OTLP gRPC (Envoy → Collector) | `service.name=contour`, 2 span types per request: `ingress` + `router … egress` |
| Metrics | **Flowing** | Prometheus scrape | `contour_*` from control plane, `envoy_*` from data plane |
| Logs | **Not flowing** | — | Stdout only; no OTLP log export |

### Verification Commands

```bash
echo "=== Traces ===" && wc -l /tmp/otel-eval-contour/traces.jsonl
echo "=== Metrics ===" && wc -l /tmp/otel-eval-contour/metrics.jsonl
echo "=== Logs ===" && wc -l /tmp/otel-eval-contour/logs.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo "No logs"

# Check service names in traces
cat /tmp/otel-eval-contour/traces.jsonl | jq -r '.resourceSpans[].resource.attributes[] | select(.key == "service.name") | .value.stringValue' | sort | uniq -c

# Check metric sources
cat /tmp/otel-eval-contour/metrics.jsonl | jq -r '.resourceMetrics[].resource.attributes[] | select(.key == "service.name") | .value.stringValue' | sort | uniq -c
```
